VisioFix test pages

Each page has known accessibility bugs and lists what VisioFix should do with them. Open the VisioFix popup on a page to compare its counts with the expected ones. To see a change, right-click an element and choose Inspect: everything VisioFix changed carries a data-visiofix attribute naming what it set.

  • Legacy bugs: things the Android version broke. Nothing may be removed.
  • Unlabeled controls: links, buttons and form fields with no name.
  • Images: missing alt text, captions, tracking pixels, lazy and hidden images.
  • ARIA: invalid roles, broken references, aria-hidden on focusable elements.
  • Headings: missing h1, skipped level, empty heading (report only).
  • Content that loads later: VisioFix keeps up with changes.
  • Heavy page: 3,000 cards plus constant changes, for checking speed.
  • Article: Focus Mode on a news story (Readability).
  • Not an article: Focus Mode on a home page (fallback, with a notice).
  • Article on a locked-down site: the same story served with a strict Content Security Policy (no outside fonts, no inline styles, Trusted Types). Focus Mode must still open and look the same, though it may use the system font.
